policy.namespace_locality: Scalar source, scalar floating destination, scalar integer destination, TLSU/TALLOC, and bundle DataType codes are distinct namespaces. Equal integers do not imply equal types across namespaces.
policy.reserved_codes: Every unmapped code rejects before architectural effects; helper fallback values are unreachable after legality succeeds and are not architectural aliases.
policy.raw_carrier_boundary: Widths and signedness describe Stage 4 raw carriers only. Floating bit layouts and target numeric results remain S5-T2 rules.
policy.four_bit_packing: E2M1X2, E1M2X2, HiF4X2, S4X2, and U4X2 use low-index/low-nibble and odd-index/high-nibble packing with sibling preservation on stores.
policy.pd02_boundary: The 0.58.0 type identities and format contract are fixed, while operation/type legality, target execution results, and implementation conformance remain open under S5-T2.
policy.value_class_boundary: TileNumericValueClass defines only bit-exact encoding classes and canonical NaN values. It does not select arithmetic results, exception flags, operation/type support, or target conformance.
